# Values from second table (in thousands of dollars)

# Wool and manufactures, months Feb-June 1940

months = ['Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'June']
print('Tobacco values (thousands):', list(zip(months, tobacco)))

# Absolute difference in thousands

# Convert to millions
diff_millions = diff_thousands / 1000
print(f'Absolute difference (millions): {diff_millions}')

# Rounded to nearest hundredths
result = round(diff_millions, 2)
print(f'Rounded to nearest hundredths: {result}')
"
